I will plant wheat on my 1.09-hectare plot for the meher season. I plan to get DAP and urea from the agricultural cooperative, though the supply is often delayed and never enough, so I will apply what I can afford. I will use my own saved seed from last year's harvest because improved wheat seed is hard to find and too expensive for me. My family will do most of the work—plowing with our oxen, planting, weeding, and harvesting—but I will likely hire a few extra laborers for the busy harvest period since the plot is too big for us to manage alone at that time.
